<?php
// Dev only: skips the WooCommerce setup wizard and exposes the plugin's seed and test scripts to a logged-in admin.
add_filter( 'woocommerce_enable_setup_wizard', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'woocommerce_prevent_automatic_wizard_redirect', '__return_true' );
foreach ( array( 'seed', 'run' ) as $pdblocks_dev_script ) {
	add_action(
		'admin_post_pdblocks_' . $pdblocks_dev_script,
		function () use ( $pdblocks_dev_script ) {
			if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
				wp_die( 'Forbidden' );
			}
			header( 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8' );
			require WP_CONTENT_DIR . '/pdblocks-tests/' . $pdblocks_dev_script . '.php';
			exit;
		}
	);
}
